articles.summary: Futu Holdings Limited ("Futu" or the "Company") (Nasdaq: FUTU), a leading tech-driven digitalized brokerage and wealth management platform, today announced the signing of a collaborative research agreement with the School of Business and Management of The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (“HKUST Business School”). The two parties will undertake a one-year in-depth research initiative on “AI-Powered Investing,” examining the impact of AI on users’ information acquisition, trading behaviour, investment decision-making support and platform engagement.
articles.title: Futu and HKUST Sign Agreement to Advance “AI-Powered Investing” Research

articles.summary: Hong Kong, October 30, 2026 – Futu Securities International (Hong Kong) Limited (“Futu”) today announced a collaboration with ARK Invest, a globally recognized investment management firm, to bring ARK Invest's innovative investment strategies to eligible professional investors in Hong Kong. The collaboration will broaden investors' access to global innovation opportunities, helping them position ahead of emerging technological trends and capture opportunities in the next wave of innovation.
articles.title: Futu Collaborates with ARK Invest to Bring Innovative Investment Strategies to Hong Kong
